AI Rapid Prototype Developer Level 1

Houston, TX
Job Type
Full-time
Description

About us:

ARCXIS, headquartered in Houston, Texas, is the nation's number one engineering and inspections firm, touching 1 in every 7 new homes, and operating in over 28 states. Committed to innovation and excellence, our services help to build better quality homes, more quickly, at lower cost, and with less risk. Formerly known as DPIS Builder Services, Ei Companies, Post-Tension Solutions, Ensign Building Solutions Home Energy Division, and Building Energy, ARCXIS unites extensive expertise into a single brand, offering nationwide coverage with a local touch. Our portfolio includes ABCO Construction Services, LLC, United Structural Consultants, and iPermit, amplifying our reach into the multi-family, multi-use, commercial, and pre-existing residential sectors. ARCXIS is majority owned by Saw Mill Capital, LLC (Briarcliff Manor, New York). Visit us online at www.arcxis.com.

Overview:

The AI Rapid Prototyping Developer rapidly prototypes and builds business solutions using AI-assisted development tools, low-code/no-code platforms, and modern application frameworks. As a dedicated delivery resource, this person works closely with business and technical leaders to convert ideas into working solutions—accelerating delivery, reducing development effort, and shortening the path from concept to value. The level 1 position is an entry level position for AI forward thinking users that are learning on the job how to leverage these technologies.

This is a hands-on, build-first role for someone who is comfortable moving fast, iterating in tight feedback loops, and using AI to amplify their output across the full prototype-to-production lifecycle.

Primary Responsibilities

Translate business ideas, requirements, and pain points into functional prototypes and working applications, often within days rather than weeks.
Use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate development, generate boilerplate, debug, and explore solution options.
Build solutions on low-code/no-code platforms and modern application frameworks, selecting the right tool for each problem.
Partner directly with business stakeholders and technical leaders to clarify goals, validate assumptions, and demo early and often.
Iterate quickly based on user feedback, refining prototypes toward production-ready quality where needed.
Integrate solutions with existing systems, APIs, and data sources.
Document what was built, how it works, and how it can be maintained or scaled by other teams.
Identify opportunities where AI-assisted or low-code approaches can replace slower, more costly traditional development.
Maintain a pragmatic balance between speed and quality—knowing when a quick prototype is enough and when engineering rigor is required.
Requirements
Experience with AI-assisted coding technologies, Claude, Codex, Github CoPilot
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and basic DevOps concepts.
Exposure to prompt engineering and getting reliable, structured output from large language models.
Basic understanding of security, privacy, and data-handling best practices when building business solutions.

Reports to: AI Integration Lead

Core Competencies

Bias for action: Defaults to building and demonstrating rather than only planning.
Adaptability: Comfortable choosing among many tools and switching approaches as needed.
Stakeholder partnership: Builds trust with business and technical leaders through clear communication and frequent delivery.
Judgment: Knows when "fast and good enough" is right and when robustness matters.
Curiosity: Continuously explores new AI and low-code capabilities and brings them into the team's toolkit.

Supervisory Responsibility: None

Work Environment: In Office

Physical Demands: None

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work: Full Time

Travel: Periodic travel to field to support training and development efforts related to the systems and process improvement.

Classification: Non-exempt
